opportunities.best_time: 清晨至日出後；以斷崖、山壁或海岸仍部分可辨為前提
opportunities.best_season: 全年候選；官方資料記錄清晨濃霧、山巒若隱若現與日出後雲霧散開的景觀

condition_variants.variant_name: 晨霧繞斷崖、山巒若隱若現
condition_variants.condition_geometry: {"camera_zone":"崇德步道目前開放觀景平台 Camera Zone","subject":"Pacific Ocean + partially visible Qingshui Cliff / mountain + morning mist or low cloud"}
condition_variants.hard_gates: 崇德步道／觀景平台合法可達；無現場封閉；不得把低能見度本身視為晨霧一定存在；拍攝點若進入白牆濃霧則不成立
condition_variants.required_conditions: 清晨或可見光時段；斷崖、山壁或海岸至少部分可辨；低能見度需有霧、低雲、高濕、低雲底或 weather code 等至少一項氣象佐證；無明顯降雨
condition_variants.boosters: 局部霧帶繞過山壁；弱風；日出前後斜射光；多項霧訊號一致
condition_variants.penalties: 拍攝平台本身白牆；斷崖與海岸完全不可辨；只有單一低能見度數值而缺乏其他霧訊號；大雨或強風

viewpoints.note: Official evidence establishes morning mist as a real Qingshui Cliff scene and the currently open Chongde trail/viewing platforms as a Qingshui Cliff viewing area. This is an area anchor, not an exact tripod point.

opportunities.evidence_summary: Taroko/National Park official material documents Qingshui Cliff mornings with dense mist, mountains appearing and disappearing through mist, and cloud/mist changing as the sun rises. Runtime weather is used only to estimate when this verified scene may occur.
